source: actual synthetic RGB and depth used for the original degraded-model reconstruction; no newly sampled calibration cameras
normal_source: derived from saved expected depth with camera-facing five-point cross-product stencil; no archived normal files exist
rgb_resize: original 1920x1440 PNG downsampled Lanczos, preserving FOV
depth_definition: saved accumulated D divided by saved alpha at native 480x360
reference_valid: saved alpha>=0.9; finite expected depth 0.1..12; all training views, no reachability/ROI filtering
loss: mean RGB L1 + clipped relative depth error + 0.15*(1-dot(depth normals)); normal missing on low but valid on reference receives penalty 1
primary_state: RGBDN, unchanged evidence strength and loss threshold; full-input RGBD ablation saved separately
state_scope: per-Gaussian scalar; no front/back states or online updates; probabilities are evidence-model states, not calibrated correctness frequencies
score: legacy fixed-snapshot masked feature rendering and per-frame mean, using one fixed state for all trajectories
unobserved: support<=1e-10 remains p=.5 and is flagged separately

versions.normal_tests: plane orientation, scale invariance, invalid stencil, discontinuity passed
